cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club's changing the menu. You kept our cast lists quiet once I stopped you winking at the actors. Can you do that again? Then I'll tell you why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You used to start with 'don't tell anyone' and tell everyone. The chef's leaving. Can you keep treating him normally?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stop asking him about next month's rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That would tell him you know. Ask as usual. He's leaving to open a café with me; I need to know you can still look surprised.
